motivation: R87D1 established local AVX512/AVX2 endpoint sensitivity but does not isolate differences between the previously used torch2.10 and2.13 stacks. This follow-up changes torch alone on one host, forcing AVX2 in both cells.
H: A torch2.10.0+cpu versus2.13.0+cpu package substitution can change original selected endpoints on the same CPU with the same Python, NumPy, sklearn, transitive Python dependencies, data and explicit AVX2 dispatch.

T.software_substitution: Installtorch2.13 CPU and shared dependencies once; installtorch2.10 CPU with --no-deps into isolated target directory and prepend that directory to PYTHONPATH only for the210 subprocesses. Capture all actual package/build paths and reject wrong version.
T.bridge: Original-versus-instrumented exact JSON on1202 in each torch cell before main known-cohort execution.
T.held_out_test: Existing original runner test evaluations retained for known-cohort diagnosis only; not used to retune thresholds or code.

D.controls: Report whether data, initial state, all shuffled/minibatch draws and non-torch package versions match; if not, distinguish earlier data/RNG/init change from numerical-optimization-only drift.
D.endpoint_change: OBSERVED if any of eight paired selected budgets differs; report all eight pairs and numeric changes even without budget changes.
D.repeatability: Four repeated seed/cell outcomes and trace ledgers must be checked exactly.
D.historical_parity: Compare original per-seed selected budgets and selected test-accuracy differences under unchanged tolerances; no replacement of historical summary.
D.statistics: Original20000 paired seed bootstrap with RNG991200, descriptive only, not new independent confirmation.

C: An API-compatibletorch substitution can still change bundled native libraries; this is a package/build intervention, not a claim about a unique operator or source commit.
ATenAVX2 does not constrain every external MKL/oneDNN dispatch path; both packages run on the same host and build metadata is preserved.
Both old/new versions may have the same endpoints even when intermediate values differ.
U: No cross-hardware guarantee, independent dataset evidence, fresh confirmation or performance benchmark.
